name: tracker-ended-run-disposition
goal: After a Tracker run ends, keep live attempts intact and move the item to a durable retry or a real block. Show Running, Queued or Blocked in Hub.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Daniel confirmed lifecycle, Hub, and both Macs. Recovery admission currently reports a capacity hold before writing a run; opted-out or blocked work can stay in progress after the run ends.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing managed tmux recovery E2E expects zero durable retries while capacity is full, and does not assert the item status after stop. The linked-Mac overview test explicitly expects the legacy no-run label. Strengthen these existing scenarios.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The committed isolated tmux regression fails at 8c9bb6d3c7: expected blocked with a real opt-out reason, received in_progress with no blocked reason.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Journal the queued recovery before admission, use observed session startup to restore active state, block ended runs for preserved reasons, retain guarded answer and live-work behavior, and show the new states in Hub.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
